title: OPPO, vivo, Xiaomi, Honor Launch Joint Android Sideloading Verification
summary: OPPO, vivo, Xiaomi, and Honor have launched an Android sideloading developer identity verification \(ADV\) mechanism in mainland China, with mutual recognition of each company&\#x27;s verification results. Apps already registered and listed on the four vendors&\#x27; open platforms are submitted automatically, according to the report, while unverified apps trigger an "unverified" warning during sideload installation that users must manually confirm to proceed. The report frames ADV as linking developers to their apps so users can identify app origin and assess safety, but it provides no technical specification, rollout timeline, or details on what data is checked.
